clips.title: Speed Meets The Real Annabelle Doll
clips.hook: MEETING ANNABELLE IN REAL LIFE GONE WRONG!
clips.reason: Features a recognizable pop culture artifact (Annabelle) combined with Speed's chaotic energy and hilarious interaction ('Messi or Ronaldo?'). Strong hook and highly shareable.

clips.title: Speed Names A Creepy Doll
clips.hook: NAMING THIS HAUNTED DOLL WAS A MISTAKE!
clips.reason: Hilarious comedic timing as Speed names a creepy doll 'Stephine' and immediately gets freaked out by it watching him. Highly relatable and funny.

clips.title: Creepy Toy Moves On Its Own
clips.hook: THE HAUNTED TOY MOVED BY ITSELF ON LIVE STREAM!
clips.reason: Paranormal activity combined with immediate panic. Good tension and genuine freak-out, though the resolution relies on the surrounding dialogue.
